meta.title: 5 Stoic keys to a genuinely happier life

beats.text: Five Stoic keys to a genuinely happier life.
One. Want what you already have. Imagine losing it, and you'll fall in love with it again.
Two. Spend your energy only on what's actually yours to control. Drop the rest.
Three. Do your work fully — then release the outcome. You own the effort, never the result.
Four. Choose your judgements with care. Your world is coloured by the meaning you give it.
Five. Be useful. The Stoics knew happiness is a by-product of a life well spent, never the target.
Happiness, they taught, isn't out there to be chased. It's a way of meeting what's already here.
